This small plot is my coffee and a few fruit trees near the house, only a tiny piece of my land. I don't buy fertilizer for it — the bag is too expensive for such a small area, and I save the little cash I have for the maize plot where it matters more. I throw the household manure and coffee pulp under the trees, and my husband and I weed and prune when we have time. The trees are already there from years before, so I don't buy new seed, and rain is enough — I have no way to irrigate.
